facts.claim: Unit 200 splits a C3/C4 mix: propane overhead, butane bottoms. Design feed 120 m3/h, column has 55 trays.
20LFB10CF002 was deliberately detuned at commissioning because upstream feed composition swings caused oscillation in the first week.
20LFC20AP001 mechanical seal failed from dry running. 20LFC20AA102 failed open during an instrument air pressure dip and drained 20LFC20BB001.
MOC-2019-021 (Rev 1) added low-low level trip 20LFC20CL101 on both reflux pumps, check valves 20LFC20AA011 and 20LFC20AA012, and low-flow alarm 20LFC20CF101.
MOC-2020-014 (Rev 2) upsized 20LFC20AA101 trim from Cv 45 to Cv 75 for higher feed rates. Side effect: the valve hunts below about 40% load, so operators run 20LFC20CF002 in manual below 40%.
20LFC10AA191 set pressure was lowered from 17.2 to 16.5 barg after inspection re-evaluated column MAWP. The Drive datasheet still says 17.2.
MOC-2022-007 (Rev 3) added bypass 20LFB20AA001 around 20LFB20AC001 to hold feed temperature as 20LFB20AC001 fouled. Cleaning interval is 18 months, last cleaned 2024-03.
MOC-2023-009: 20LFC30CT001 moved from tray 28 to tray 32 because the tray 28 reading was insensitive. 20LFC30CT002 setpoint changed from 78 to 81 C and the loop was retuned (Rev 4).
Near-miss: 20LFC20BB001 overfilled during startup with 20LFC20CL002 left in manual.
MOC-2024-031 (Rev 5) changed 20LFC20AA102 fail position from fail-open to fail-closed, accepting overfill risk covered by the high-level alarm.
During PM, Priya found the 20LFC20AA102 actuator still configured fail-open and raised WO-88213. Closure was never recorded.
Opening the 20LFB20AC001 bypass makes bottoms run hotter to storage. Off-page storage alarm 20LFD10CT101 trips at 55 C, so operators only partially open 20LFB20AA001. Spans PID-100 and PID-300.
Dana's rule: never start a reflux pump unless 20LFC20BB001 level is at least 30%.
20LFC20AP001 seal was replaced again in June 2021 (WO-71120). Suspected cause was misalignment rather than dry running, so 20LFC20AP002 is the preferred duty pump.

contradictions.summary: Set pressure is 17.2 barg in the datasheet and drawing but 16.5 barg per Hannah (Slack, 2021). Correct current value: 16.5 barg, but only supported by Slack.
Fail position is FC per Rev 5 drawing and MOC-2024-031, but Priya found FO in the field in 2025 and the work order was never closed. True current state is unknown.

gaps.summary: No maintenance history or incidents for 20LFB10AP002.
No MOC or approval document for the 20LFC10AA191 re-rating.
No explanation anywhere for why the 20LFC20AA102 bypass line is 2 inch.
20LFC30AC001 steam trap sizing basis is undocumented.
Pump vendors, heat duties, and most design pressures are never stated.
